metadata.description: Agent-use-ready US equity investment-intelligence skills and plugins for Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, OpenClaw, Goose, and Claude Cowork. Backed by agentii.ai's data API (SEC filings, XBRL facts, earnings calendar) with three-layer retrieval protocol and two-tier page outline (v2.2.2).

plugins.name: agentii
plugins.description: Unified meta-plugin — all 31 skills across 5 verticals under a single /agentii:skill-name namespace. The recommended single install.

plugins.name: equity-research-core
plugins.description: 9 equity-research dimension skills with ~48 addressable sub-prompt modes: recent-quarter performance, business-model analysis, competitive landscape, growth strategy, secular tech trends, turnaround analysis, risk analysis, earnings sentiment, and valuation methods.

plugins.name: business-intelligence
plugins.description: 4 business-intelligence skills: revenue decomposition, unit economics, what-if scenarios, and operational KPI tracking.

plugins.name: industry-analysis
plugins.description: 4 industry-analysis skills: peer benchmarking, sector overview, competitive positioning, and supply-chain mapping.

plugins.name: models-and-pitches
plugins.description: 9 financial-modeling + presentation skills: DCF, comps, 3-statement, LBO, SOTP-valuation, audit-xls, xlsx-financials, earnings-preview, and pitch-deck. All Excel-producing skills follow the FR-044 4-step office protocol (spec → build → recalc → audit).

plugins.name: quantitative-analysis
plugins.description: 5 quantitative-analysis skills: ratio-analysis, PEG-valuation, reverse-DCF, DDM-valuation, and residual-income / EVA.

plugins.name: agentii-equity-agent
plugins.description: Orchestrating agent plugin bundling all 31 skills from the 5 vertical plugins, with capability-isolated subagents (retrieval, analytical, BI, visualization) and a three-layer retrieval protocol system prompt.
